scope_statement: Demonstration only; never bound. Creates one private directory in the signed parent and the signed files in it, runs one attached container that writes through a bind of that directory, and recreates one compose service under the deployment lock with an explicit file list. Its table carries the fixed row that prints two named entries of a container's environment; its run never starts it. Nothing that exists is overwritten, renamed, chmodded, chowned or removed, except the temporary of this run once its identity is proved.
